parsed.main_gap: The 'elementary infinite sunflower fact' (3) is stated for arbitrary infinite families of distinct finite sets, where it is false; only the bounded-size case (which is what is used) is valid.

errors.description: Claim (3) is asserted for any infinite family of distinct finite sets. This is false (e.g. a chain {1}⊂{1,2}⊂{1,2,3}⊂... contains no infinite sunflower), and the sketched induction ('delete that element, and continue') only terminates when set sizes are bounded. Hence Lemma 1's general statement is unproved; fortunately only the bounded instance |C|≤K is used later, and for that the sketch is a valid induction on the size bound, so the gap is repairable.
